steps.surface: Top bar in a narrow computer window
steps.path: The YouCoded window on a computer, dragged narrow
steps.headline: Narrow computer window: Projects moves into ☰, the name sits on the left, and the window can't be made too narrow.
steps.changed: Your note: "projects should probably get folded into the 3-line menu and the session name become left-aligned, then the window should block itself from being made smaller to prevent overlap". All three are done. The window now stops shrinking at 340 pixels wide, where ☰, the name, the terminal switch and the window buttons still fit side by side.
steps.notice: Only windows with their own Minimize / Maximize / Close (or a Mac's three coloured buttons) change. Phones keep Projects on the bar, as you approved last round.
steps.risk: The window minimum can't be shown in a picture; try dragging a dev window narrow to feel it. A Mac is described, not pictured.

steps.path: Tap the session name at the top of the Android app
steps.headline: Session rows now start and end 12 pixels in, lined up with the "Your sessions" heading.
steps.changed: Your note: "make the left/right margin on each session row a bit more consistent, and also make it better match the 'your sessions' line margin". Each row's name, folder, status and model now sit inside the same edges as the heading.
steps.notice: The left edge of every name lines up with the Y of "Your sessions".

steps.path: Under and above the message box, on a phone browser connected to your computer
steps.headline: Pills and shortcut chips now share one 24-pixel height; the green glow is faint and the pencil is fixed.
steps.changed: Your notes: "reduce that green glow a LOT", "the edit icon is broken, way too small", "could we possibly try shrinking quick chips in the same way on mobile? and … just a smidge taller so everything is still touch friendly?" Pills went from 20 to 24 pixels; the shortcut chips from 32 to 24. Both edit pencils are 24-pixel squares.
steps.notice: The two rows match again, and the bottom of the screen is about one line shorter than today.
steps.measured: Pills and chips 24 px tall (today: chips 32 px, pills 20–24 px of mixed shapes)
steps.risk: 24 px is still under the 32 px finger size master set for phones; taps near an edge may miss.
